Supported content only:full style/number-format/layout/font metadata,objects,rich/multiline text,merged/matrix/group/external/legacy formulas,repeated formula services,full cache/version/recalc policies and complete document/shell/import constructors remain unported. Unsupported metadata emits concrete diagnostics;unsupported cell semantics reject. This is not lossless full-ODF or UI parity. ScDocumentPool exports only original contiguous character prefix100..124; no defaults are invented for unsupported cell/page items. Device-based initialization/script scanning,rich/wrapped/rotated/merged layout,drawing/hidden rows and standalone height dialogs remain unported. Nonstandard represented attribute profiles decline adjustment;unrepresented foreign layout properties,mixed-script text and device layout remain unverified.
